subject: English
question_text: Complete the following table with information from the passage.
stimulus: (Neil Armstrong) Event Year/Time Place Achievement Born (i) _______ Received BSc (ii) _______ Left for the moon (iii) _______ 20 July 1969 (iv) _______ Died (v) _______
guide_solution: (i) on August 5, 1930 (ii) Purdue University (iii) on July 16, 1969 (iv) Landing on the moon (v) on August 25, 2012
